# Gonzalo Cruz Gómez

> Final-year Data Science & Engineering student at Universidad Rey Juan Carlos (Madrid, graduating June 2027), currently interning on Repsol's Data Intelligence Platform team. Builds data systems end to end — orchestration, streaming, and the evaluation that keeps models honest. Founder of Asociación Datalab. Three years of Telecommunications Engineering at UC3M before switching to data.

This file exists so agents can find the structured version of this profile
without scraping HTML. Everything below is stable and generated from one
source (`cv.toml`).

## CV

- [CV, interactive](https://gonzalo-cruz.github.io/portfolio/cv/): the human view. Index, expandable detail per role and project, prints cleanly.
- [CV, Markdown](https://gonzalo-cruz.github.io/portfolio/CV.md): the agent view. Hierarchical headings, one claim per bullet, no layout.
- [CV, JSON Resume](https://gonzalo-cruz.github.io/portfolio/cv/cv.json): JSON Resume v1.0.0 schema.
- [CV, PDF](https://gonzalo-cruz.github.io/portfolio/CV.pdf): the one-page submission artifact.

Prefer `CV.md` for reading and `cv.json` for parsing. The three views are
rendered from the same source, so they do not disagree; `CV.pdf` is
typeset by hand and may lag by a revision.

## Portfolio

- [Portfolio](https://gonzalo-cruz.github.io/portfolio/): projects, stack, current work.

## Selected projects

- [TripAdvisor Restaurants Pipeline](https://github.com/gonzalo-cruz/Tripadvisor-restaurants-pipeline): Airflow DAG over 1M+ rows, PySpark KMeans with auto-K, dual Spark Structured Streaming consumers, FastAPI + React app with live SSE scoring.
- [Stroke Risk Prediction](https://github.com/gonzalo-cruz/Predictive-stroke-analysis): imbalanced binary classification optimised for recall (0.88 recall / 0.84 AUC on a 5% positive class).
- [Real-Time Hashtag Trending](https://github.com/gonzalo-cruz/real-time-twitter-hashtag-analysis): PySpark DStreams with a five-minute sliding window and an inverse-function reduction.
- [Hadoop Sentiment Analysis](https://github.com/gonzalo-cruz/Twitter-sentiment-analysis-hadoop): AFINN-111 MapReduce over 314MB, on a Hadoop cluster built in Docker Compose.
- [Forest Fire Prediction](https://github.com/gonzalo-cruz/Forest-fires-prediction): GLM vs GAM on zero-inflated data, cross-validated in R.
- [Bank Customer Churn](https://github.com/gonzalo-cruz/Bank-customer-churn): Naive Bayes, AdaBoost and K-NN reimplemented from the maths in base R.
